title: [Main]-Payment discount tolerance is doubled when posting a vendor payment
summary: Fixed a bug where payment discount tolerance was calculated twice for vendor payments with Applies-to ID in foreign currency, causing inflated bank amounts and sign errors in GL entries.
key_points: Removed the GenJnlLineApplID = '' guard so the netted payment amount is saved to the journal line in the Applies-to ID case
Added a re-entrancy guard in PmtTolGenJnl to stop recursion when Amount is validated
Vendor payments applied to several invoices in foreign currency no longer double the discount tolerance
Fix made in the W1, CH, FR, IT and NL layers; customer path unchanged
Regression tests added in W1 and IT vendor payment tolerance test codeunits
